description: List connected social accounts (X/Twitter, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Mastodon and Telegram; Threads, Instagram and Facebook coming soon), with `accounts_limit` (how many the plan allows to be active) and `accounts_active` (how many are) beside them, which say whether there is room to connect another. Accounts with `is_active: false` are connected but not publishing; `inactive_reason` says why: `"plan_limit"` means the account was connected while the plan's account limit was already full and can be switched on with chirpie_activate_account, while `"token_revoked"`, `"token_expired"` and `"reauth_required"` mean the platform stopped accepting the stored credential, so the account has to be connected again and anything it had scheduled was cancelled with its quota returned. Retrying a post does not bring an inactive account back: `inactive_reason` says whether chirpie_activate_account or a fresh connect does. An account switched off deliberately carries no reason at all, and chirpie_activate_account switches it back on. Reconnecting an account already held never needs a free slot. `scheduled_posts` is how many scheduled posts are queued against the account, all of which chirpie_deactivate_account would cancel. On LinkedIn, `account_type` says whether the account is the member's own profile (`"member"`) or a LinkedIn Page they administer (`"organization"`); both post the same way, with their own `id`.
name: chirpie_list_accounts
title: List connected accounts
